item.tib: snyan rgyud ye dbang chen mo'i lag len mun gling sgron gsal
item.coloph: lag len mun gling sgron shar 'di/ khyung btsun rtogs ldan rnam gnyis kyis/ yang yang nan tan bskul ba'i ngor/ rkong (kong) khams 'dres pa'i btsun chung gis/ bdag 'dra blo rmongs rnams la ni/ phan pa'i phyir du gu ger brgyud/ tshad ma gsum gyi sgo nas bsgrigs/ nyes 'gal byung srid lha la bshags//
